title: Source Atlas public R2 Worker gateway owner approval
approval_scope: Deploy a Cloudflare Worker gateway for Source Atlas public/reference packs.
Bind the gateway to R2 bucket ambitions-source-atlas-prod.
Expose only explicit allowlisted production stable occupation_foundation object keys.
Use the endpoint for live native URLSession fetch proof.
blocked_exposure_modes: Do not enable bucket-wide r2.dev public access in this train.
Do not expose a bucket listing route.
Do not expose arbitrary source-atlas/* object keys.
Do not expose private user context, goals, captures, schedules, proof, receipts, account identifiers, device identifiers, or private graph data.
Do not claim production custom-domain readiness from workers.dev proof.
reason_for_worker_gateway_instead_of_r2_: Bucket info reports 68 objects, while known generated proof artifacts identify 41 unique object keys. Bucket-wide r2.dev would expose unknown object keys if guessed. The Worker gateway allowlist exposes only the approved public/reference object keys needed for live native transport proof.

cloudflare_docs_review.finding: Cloudflare-managed r2.dev URLs are for development and expose public bucket access; production control should use a custom domain or a controlled gateway.
Workers can access R2 through a binding and fetch objects by key.

wrangler_cli_review.summary: Enable public access via r2.dev is a bucket-wide public access operation and supports --force.

non_claims: not a final user plan, schedule, or Step generator
approval_source: User authorized work needed to get Source Atlas green in production target, legal approval, live transport, R2 write, runtime/release Green, and universal coverage areas. This artifact scopes that authorization to a bounded public/reference Worker gateway only and does not convert it into outside legal or release approval.
rollback_plan: Disable or delete the Cloudflare Worker gateway if public endpoint exposure must be revoked.
No bucket-wide r2.dev setting should be enabled by this train.
R2 objects remain managed by existing revocation/LKG/rollback proof.
